Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity redesign concept for Artifacts, a personal library of retained HTML/Markdown artifacts with projects, revisions, previews and protected publication.
Style: polished, implementable desktop web application inspired by shadcn/ui components, Lucide outline icons, clean Inter typography. Straight-on crisp screen capture, landscape 16:10, one complete screen, no device frame, no perspective, no surrounding poster or explanatory annotations. Render Spanish interface text cleanly and legibly.
Shared design system: fixed 224px left sidebar in Mantle #181825, main background Base #1e1e2e, subtle Crust #11111b divisions, cards with restrained Surface 0 #313244 borders, Blue #89b4fa primary buttons and selected navigation, Sapphire #74c7ec chart accents, Lavender #b4befe minor accents, Text #cdd6f4 and muted #a6adc8. 90% solid matte surfaces. Restrained glow only on chart line, no glassmorphism, no pervasive gradients. Rounded 12px cards, 8px buttons, 1px borders, generous but purposeful spacing. Small professional controls, clear hierarchy.
Shared sidebar: small layered geometric icon + wordmark "Artifacts", subtitle "Tu espacio de trabajo"; navigation items "Biblioteca", "Proyectos"; divider; small uppercase "TUS PROYECTOS"; folder links "Producto", "Investigación", "Sitio web"; bottom link "Conectar herramientas" with plug icon, and compact account row "Mi cuenta". Keep precisely this sidebar shell and typography in all screens. Top horizontal bar: breadcrumb at left, search field "Buscar artefactos..." with command-K hint at right, theme icon.
Constraints: real usable product UI, no finance metrics, no fake team collaboration, no new-artifact editor button because creation happens through connected tools. Example data is fictional. Do not show technology names or palette hex codes in the image. No watermark.
Screen: Biblioteca, active sidebar Biblioteca. Main title "Biblioteca", subtitle "Todo lo que creas, en un solo lugar.", right-aligned primary blue "Conectar herramientas".
Under heading a compact single-row three-part overview: "24 artefactos", "16 publicados", "4 con cambios pendientes". Make these quiet summaries, not giant dashboard tiles.
Below: status tabs "Todos 24", "Publicados 16", "Sin publicar 8", "Cambios pendientes 4". Right controls "Más recientes" and grid/list toggle with grid selected.
Main area: beautiful 3-column by 2-row grid of six artifact cards with spacious miniature rendered HTML previews taking 60% of each card, then a title, project label, publication badge, revision and updated time, plus ellipsis menu. Cards titles: "Panel de métricas", "Guía de marca", "Mapa de investigación", "Landing de producto", "Comparativa de soluciones", "Plan de lanzamiento". Previews should be distinct authentic visual documents: blue area chart dashboard, typography/color design guide, structured research diagram, restrained landing page, comparison table, roadmap. No large photographic images. First card "Panel de métricas" belongs to "Producto" and has badge "Cambios pendientes", "Revisión 8". Others mix "Publicado" and "Sin publicar". Bottom subtle "Mostrando 6 de 24 artefactos" and "Ver más".
